pick.headline: Kim Philby dies in Moscow
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of May 13, 1988, carried Moscow TASS in Russian: an obituary praising 'the remarkable Soviet intelligence officer Kim Philby', his decades inside Western special services, and his arrival in Moscow in 1963.
